Title: MCP Search Tools Current State
Content: The MCP endpoint at /mcp exposes 22+ tools via HTTP JSON-RPC. Read tools (Chat+MCP): memorysmith_search (lexical), memorysmith_semantic_search (ONNX or token fallback), memorysmith_hybrid_search (RRF fusion), memorysmith_context_pack (linked reference graph), memorysmith_get (by ID), memorysmith_page_search, memorysmith_page_get, memorysmith_unified_search (memories+pages combined), memorysmith_task_list, memorysmith_task_get, memorysmith_code_search (vector+lexical hybrid with prefilter), memorysmith_code_search_status. Write tools (MCP+Agent, Edit permission): memorysmith_task_create/update/set_status/add_comment/add_attachment, memorysmith_page_save/delete, memorysmith_code_search_merge_shard, memorysmith_memory_create, memorysmith_memory_update (governed via proposal workflow). Source tools (MCP only): memorysmith_source_bundle, memorysmith_find_by_source. Search input is plain text with optional tags/status/limit filters. Structured output via format=json or format=envelope returns retrieval envelopes with provider metadata.
